sources.title: Alan overview
sources.finding: Local and paid cloud sessions support multiple coding agents; shared sessions allow teammates to steer together. Tests run when asked or configured, not automatically on every change.

sources.title: Alan downloads
sources.finding: macOS 13+, Windows 10/11 x64 and Arm, Linux x86_64 AppImage and deb. Download page lists Windows 0.3.124.

sources.title: Alan pricing
sources.finding: Free local sessions; Individual and Team Pro start at $10 monthly per seat. Pro/Pro+/Max give $10/$50/$100 credit with cloud limited to a quarter. No automatic overages and no self-hosted license.

sources.title: Task detail
sources.finding: Tasks retain editable properties, brief, subtasks, attachments, activity, linked PRs and multiple sessions. Changes panel supports commit, push, create and link PRs.

sources.title: Start a session
sources.finding: Agent or read-only Plan mode, local desktop and connected remote targets, cloud, shared sessions, transcript and artifact navigation.

sources.title: Coding agents and models
sources.finding: Lists Alan Code, Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor Agent, Droid, Antigravity, Grok Build, Kimi, Command Code and OpenCode. Availability is target-specific; hosted models and custom providers are separate.

sources.title: Roles and permissions
sources.finding: Organization and team Admin/Member roles; invitation links expire in seven days. Team or Enterprise is required for teams and membership.

sources.title: Automations
sources.finding: Saved instructions run in cloud sessions on schedules, selected GitHub/Bitbucket/Alan events or custom webhooks; unavailable picker entries remain excluded.

sources.title: Alan 0.3.125
sources.finding: Release dated 2026-11-24 adds pilots and shared memory, and fixes stop states, chat reload and credential failures.

sources.title: Alan plan skill
sources.finding: Product-shipped skill invokes create_plan with task, conversation and team IDs; revisions use parentId and get_artifact. Prompt policy is not backend enforcement.

sources.title: GitHub plugin MCP configuration
sources.finding: HTTP GitHub MCP connection uses api.githubcopilot.com/mcp and GITHUB_TOKEN header substitution.

sources.title: Alan feature-test skill
sources.finding: The public skill requests browser tests, screenshots/video, presigned S3 uploads and a task/session/team-linked structured report with commits and changed files. These are instructions and tool contracts, not backend enforcement.

sources.title: Alan PR review skill
sources.finding: The public prompt names authenticated Alan GitHub MCP operations for details, diffs, files, CI, reviews/comments and merge. It requests inline findings and a linked summary; tool implementations are closed.

sources.title: Alan plugin gateway and package contract
sources.finding: Pinned README documents marketplace pinning, remote MCP routing and skills; scripts/validate.mjs rejects stdio servers. docs/composio-personal-deployment.md restricts managed Composio packages to personal accounts pending configured deployment and provider verification. Package declarations do not prove live backend execution.

sources.title: Alan privacy policy
sources.locator: Information/use; agent/workspace data; Slack/Teams; retention; rights
sources.finding: Policy discloses service processing and usage analytics, no workspace-model training without explicit consent, account-active retention until deletion, and email export/deletion requests. It does not specify a telemetry startup default or complete off-switch.
